what: On first open, the ”Loading” letters at the center of the background-color curtain covering the screen rise from 5px below and transparent at .2s intervals over 1s power4.out, pause .1s and repeat once more, then pause .2s. As the text line fades over .5s, the curtain also lifts over 1.5s power4.out (fx:reveal — turn on the hero copy here). When fully lifted, the curtain is hidden and fx:done fires. Runs only the first time in the same window.

options.dur: Duration of one character rising into view (sec), default 1
options.times: How many times it rises, default 2 (original repeat 1)
options.hold: Time until text lines fade after fully surfacing (sec), default .2
options.veil: Duration of the curtain lifting (s), default 1.5 — shorten for screens opened often like an app
options.every: With true, every time it opens (default: only the first time in the same window)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Center text line (Loading) — a motion part splits the letters. If absent, only the curtain lifts
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: (optional) Separate curtain to lift — if none, the element the part is attached to is the curtain

note: The moment the veil lifts, fx:reveal is fired on document, and fx:done when everything ends (both immediately with reduced motion or on a second visit)

from.where: shared.js .ky-intro — original [data-intro]: letters y 5→0·opacity 1s .2 stagger repeat 1·repeatDelay .1 Power4.easeOut, text lines .5s (.2 delayed), overlay [data-intro-overlay-first] 1.5s at the same time, first phrase letters start 1s after that at .2 stagger.
